source_title: In Which Currency Are The Prices Shown
snippet_primary: "Domestika doesn't apply commissions or taxes relating to the exchange rate between currencies. However, your bank or payment processor may add an additional fee and so we suggest that you contact them directly to confirm their policy regarding this."
subject_exact: Domestika help center (article 360003316798, undated) states Domestika does not apply commissions or taxes on currency exchange; banks or payment processors may add additional fees
local_qualifiers: Domestika applies no commissions or taxes on currency exchange; third-party bank/processor fees may apply
parser_notes: support.domestika.org article 360003316798 (undated). Currency exchange: no Domestika fees; bank/processor may charge additional.
